text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There is no more doubt in Symboli<n>Rudolf's eyes.
She sees her path<n>clearly, and it leads her to a
storied<n>race of great prestige.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The newly reborn Emperor is ready to<n>compete in
the spring Tenno Sho,<n>where she will surely set a
tempest<n>whirling.
